replacement.name: Vivanta Guwahati
replacement.tagline: Taj's 5-star Khanapara wing, 150 rooms, full-service spa, indoor and outdoor pools — the city's most polished business-leisure hotel set on a quiet ridge above GS Road.
replacement.address: Plot 613, Mahapurush Srimanta Sankardev Road, Khanapara, Guwahati 781022

replacement.name: Radisson Blu Hotel Guwahati
replacement.tagline: Rooftop pool overlooking the GS Road business strip, walking distance to Maniram Dewan Trade Centre — the city's reliable mid-luxury default for Brahmaputra and Kamakhya day trips.
replacement.address: NH-37, Gotanagar, Maligaon, Guwahati 781011

replacement.name: Hotel Brahmaputra Ashok
replacement.tagline: ITDC-Assam-Government joint venture on the Brahmaputra riverbank, 11 km to the railway station — the closest mid-tier option to the Umananda ferry and Pan Bazar promenade.
replacement.address: M.G. Road, Guwahati 781001 (Brahmaputra riverfront)

replacement.name: Thengal Manor
replacement.tagline: 1929 Barooah-family mansion in Jalukonibari village, 15 km from Jorhat — five high-ceilinged colonial rooms, period furniture, the same lawn where Assam's first daily 'Dainik Batori' was launched in 1935.
replacement.address: Jalukonibari Village, Mariani, Jorhat District 785637, Assam

replacement.name: Hotel Earl Grey
replacement.tagline: 3-star with a garden terrace 6 km from Jorhat Airport — clean, polite-managed, the best mid-budget option in town for Kaziranga or Majuli ferry mornings.
replacement.address: AT Road, Jorhat 785001, Assam

replacement.name: Banyan Grove
replacement.tagline: Heritage tea-estate bungalow set among the Cinnamara gardens just outside Jorhat town — colonial verandah, working planter's-residence atmosphere, an easier base than Thengal Manor for tea-tour day-trippers.
replacement.address: Cinnamara Tea Estate, Jorhat 785008, Assam

replacement.name: Burra Sahib's Bungalow
replacement.tagline: Former British tea-estate manager's bungalow with an 18-hole golf course threaded through working gardens — Victorian dining room, billiards, the most unusual stay between Jorhat and Sivasagar.
replacement.address: Gatoonga Tea Estate, Jorhat 785611, Assam

replacement.name: Diphlu River Lodge
replacement.tagline: Twelve bamboo-and-thatch cottages on the park boundary along the Diphlu river — the only lodge that hosted the Duke and Duchess of Cambridge, with in-house naturalists and evening Bihu singers.
replacement.address: Bochagaon, Kaziranga National Park, Golaghat District 785609, Assam

replacement.name: Infinity Resorts Kaziranga
replacement.tagline: Sixteen garden-facing cottages built from local material, ten minutes from the Central (Kohora) gate — the easiest morning-safari pickup in the park, with the Infinity group's Corbett-style ethos.
replacement.address: NH-37, Bocha Gaon, Kaziranga National Park, Golaghat 785609, Assam

replacement.name: IORA - The Retreat, Kaziranga
replacement.tagline: Manicured 4-star set back from NH-37 at Bogorijuri, with an Assamese restaurant guests dine at twice — better-value rooms than the lodge tier and the most reliable safari-desk in Kohora.
replacement.address: NH-37, Bogorijuri, Kohora, Kaziranga National Park, Golaghat 785609, Assam

replacement.name: Wild Mahseer
replacement.tagline: 150-year-old McLeod Russel Burra Sahib's Bungalow on the Addabarie Tea Estate near Tezpur — Eastern Himalayan Botanic Ark with 1,00,000+ plants, a heritage tea-and-wildlife base for Kaziranga, Nameri and Pakke.
replacement.address: Addabarie Tea Estate, Balipara, Sonitpur District 784101, Assam

replacement.name: La Maison de Ananda
replacement.tagline: First bamboo cottage on the island, run by Monjit and family in Garamur — the pioneer that taught Majuli homestay tourism, eco-built and meal-included with home-cooked Mising fare.
replacement.address: Garamur, Majuli Island, Majuli District 785104, Assam

replacement.name: Ygdrasill Bamboo Cottage
replacement.tagline: Beda's all-bamboo cottage colony surrounded by paddy and a private bird-pond — see-through bamboo walls, attached bathrooms, the most consistently positive reviews on Majuli.
replacement.address: Garamur, Majuli Island, Majuli District 785104, Assam

replacement.name: Musa Jungle Retreat
replacement.tagline: 'Musa' is Bodo for tiger — twenty cottages on 8 acres, ten-minute walk to the Bansbari gate of the UNESCO-listed park. The most polished rooms-and-safari combo in Manas.
replacement.address: Bansbari Range, Manas National Park, Baksa District 781315, Assam

replacement.name: Bansbari Lodge
replacement.tagline: Sixteen twin-bedded rooms right at the Bansbari gate with tea gardens on one side and the foothills jungle on the other — Assam Tourism property under Assam Bengal Navigation management, the long-standing safari standard.
replacement.address: Bansbari, Manas National Park, Baksa District 781315, Assam

replacement.name: Florican Cottages
replacement.tagline: Community-run by ten youth of MEWS (Manas Ever Welfare Society) under manager Lama, beside the Bansbari gate — basic-but-clean rooms, knowledgeable safari arrangements, the budget conservation choice.
replacement.address: Bansbari, Manas National Park, Baksa District 781315, Assam

replacement.name: Mathanguri Forest Lodge
replacement.tagline: Government Forest Lodge 22 km inside the park on the Manas river, six rooms — the river the Bhutan border traces is your verandah view. Book through Manas Tiger Reserve office at Barpeta Road.
replacement.address: Mathanguri, Manas National Park, Baksa District 781315, Assam

replacement.name: Hotel Piccolo
replacement.tagline: Walking-distance (1 km) from Shiv Dol and the Sivasagar Tank — clean, spacious, and the highest-rated property in town for Ahom-monument day-tripping.
replacement.address: Boarding Road, Sivasagar 785640, Assam

replacement.name: Hotel Brahmaputra
replacement.tagline: 36 rooms in the heart of historical Sivasagar, near ONGC Sivasagar — the practical mid-budget pick when Piccolo is full, with restaurant and concierge for tank-circuit visits.
replacement.address: Near ONGC Ltd, Sivasagar Ho, Sivasagar 785640, Assam

replacement.name: Landmark Hotel Haflong
replacement.tagline: Overlooking Haflong Lake in the centre of Assam's only hill station — AC rooms, in-house dining, the most polished option in Dima Hasao with no real luxury alternative for 100 km.
replacement.address: Near Haflong Lake, Haflong, Dima Hasao District 788819, Assam

replacement.name: Nothao Lodge
replacement.tagline: 400 m from the main market — family cottages with hot water and AC, the most reliable budget bed in Haflong outside the Tourist Lodge.
replacement.address: Haflong, Dima Hasao District 788819, Assam

replacement.name: Haflong Tourist Lodge
replacement.tagline: Assam Tourism's hilltop lodge with the original Haflong Lake panorama — basic but the truest 'top-of-the-hill' position in the only Assamese hill town.
replacement.address: Tourist Lodge Road, Haflong, Dima Hasao District 788819, Assam
